QuestInfo.name: Weakening King Sage Cat
QuestInfo.0: The Head Mental Trainer of #bMu Lung#k, #bDo Gong#k, seems to be concerned about something...
QuestInfo.1: Over the course of a thousand years, the King Sage Cat has digressed from a promising Master to a vicious trickster. He put a spell on Tae Roon, and is primed to trick his way into Mu Lung. In order to weaken him, you'll first have to eliminate Sage Cats and recover #bcat dolls#k from the battle.  \n\n#i4000289# #t4000289# #b#c4000289##k/100
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the Sage Cat and found a cat doll. Do Gong placed a spell on the doll and told you to go to #b#m250010503##k to see if the spell is working properly. Go to #b#m250010503##k.

0.0: From the outside looking in, Mu Lung looks like a haven for those wanting to cloister themselves away while they better themselves. But even this remote sanctuary can't always hide from threats... such as that of the King Sage Cat.
0.1: Once a divine creature, he slowly fell from grace over the last thousand years, becoming a devious trickster. He's obsessed with taking over Mu Lung. His magic is strong and subtle. He can slip inside your head, and you may not even know it.
0.2: As far as overt attacks are concerned, he's mostly left those to his minions -- until now. He's attacking Mu Lung in earnest now, and we need to find a way to stop him. Would you be willing to help us?

yes.0: Thank you. First, we need to wear down the King Sage Cat's forces. He controls a small army of #rSage Cats#k, and relays his evil magic through #bCat Dolls#k. If we can steal away 100 of those Cat Dolls, that should slow him down, to say the least.

no.0: If you can't help us here, then... there's nothing we can do about it.

1.0: You managed to reclaim the Cat Dolls from the Sage Cats. Thank you very much. Now, if I write this sentence that I've prepared, then...

yes.0: Ah! Success! Next, please hurry to #bGoblin Forest#k. If my counterspells work properly, you'll see far fewer Sage Cats in your way.

item.0: Hmmm... You haven't managed to defeat the #rSage Cats#k and gather up #b100 Cat Dolls#k. Are you still a long way to go before collecting 100?
